criteria.name: Visual thesis
evidence: All ten pages sustain a nocturnal, tactile luxury-beauty editorial read with a clear focal point.

criteria.name: Composition
evidence: The page roles vary across cinematic image, proposition, swatch system, object grammar, material study, gesture, collection, ritual, release, and coda.

criteria.name: Material / domain fit
evidence: Oxblood, bone, champagne, macro lacquer, warm metal, portrait, hand, and application gesture all support the couture beauty domain.

criteria.name: Readability
evidence: The existing 1280x720 PNG set and contact sheet were visually inspected; no clipping, stretching, or contrast failure was found.

criteria.name: Editability
evidence: Structural inspection confirms native text boxes, auto-shapes, pictures, and SVG freeforms; swatches, silhouettes, labels, and timeline remain editable.

criteria.name: Reproducibility
evidence: build.py regenerates the 10-slide PPTX; theme-lock.yaml, design-baseline.md, acceptance-contract.md, and rendered assets are present.
inspect_pptx.py confirms native editable structure on every slide.
Reviewed render set is retained because the latest build changed only benchmark documentation, not slide geometry or copy.
theme-lock.yaml and design-baseline.md formalize the transferable system.
revision_record: Promoted the existing reviewed case into a benchmark package by adding a resolved theme lock, transfer rules, page-role map, and schema-valid acceptance record. No visual redesign was needed after inspection.
